headline_or_snippet: Reliance raises full-year revenue guidance after stronger digital demand.
Reliance cuts EBITDA outlook due to weaker refining margins.
Reliance reiterates its existing annual guidance.
A brokerage downgrades Reliance after lowering retail margin assumptions.
An analyst upgrades Reliance, citing stronger cash generation.
Reliance announces a proposed acquisition but valuation terms are not disclosed.
Reliance announces a multi-year capex plan without expected returns.
A project faces cost overruns and a delayed commissioning date.
Quarterly EBITDA rises year on year, led by digital services and retail.
Revenue grows but EBITDA declines, leaving growth quality uncertain.
Net debt rises while operating cash flow weakens.
Operating cash flow strengthens and net debt declines.
A regulator opens an inquiry; no finding of wrongdoing has been announced.
A plant outage disrupts production and reduces utilisation.
Reliance shares fall while the broad market is flat; the cause is unknown.
The board proposes a higher dividend, subject to approval.
Reliance announces a renewable-energy target without interim milestones.
Plant utilisation improves after scheduled maintenance.
Reliance shares outperform the market on elevated volume after results.
A proposed transaction is delayed pending further regulatory information.
Quarterly profit declines as input costs rise faster than revenue.
A new facility starts commercial operations on schedule and within budget.
The board declares the same dividend per share as last year.
A new regulatory requirement increases compliance costs for telecom operators.
Management reviews its outlook but does not provide revised figures.
